content.title: GDDY Q3 Deep Dive: AI Strategy and Product Expansion Drive Customer Engagement
content.summary: Domain registrar and web services company GoDaddy (NYSE:GDDY) reported Q3 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 10.3% year on year to $1.27 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $1.27 billion was less impressive, coming in 0.5% below analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $1.51 per share was 3.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
